elaboration_no_decisions_rationale: Inception is research/distillation. The architectural choices that shape the report-to-fix loop (Sentry coexistence model, OAuth callback topology, durable state-store choice between Firestore/GCS, webhook acknowledgment + Cloud Tasks vs synchronous handler) are downstream of inception and belong to the design stage where concrete approaches are weighed. Intent-level scoping decisions (fire-and-forget UX, hardcoded gigsmart/haiku-method target, client-side scrubbing, event-driven invocation, no daemons) were already settled in the design conversation that produced the discovery document and are embedded in the intent context.
